content:
We just published a list of the 10 Best 52-Week Low NASDAQ Stocks to Buy According to Billionaires and IREN (NASDAQ:IREN) ranked 10th on this list.

Scan the Nasdaq stocks hitting 52-week lows this week and a pattern jumps out: many of the biggest names build, power or rent space for artificial intelligence. Few of these businesses are shrinking. Several reported record revenue in recent weeks, and their shares kept sliding anyway.

A person with a cell phone who is looking for new stocks

A New Political Risk Arrives in Washington

Then came the election. Reuters reported on November 4 that Wall Street closed sharply higher after Democrats won Congress, but data center shares fell on fears of tighter AI regulation. Democrats made gains in Texas and Georgia, where public opposition to the industry's rapid expansion has been growing.

We also wrote about how leverage turned an AI bet into a fire sale for one fund .

The pressure carried into the next day. UBS analysts estimated that around 30% of expected US data center capacity additions in 2028 could be at risk from potential construction pauses, Reuters reported on November 5. Large technology companies, by contrast, rose on the view that a slower buildout would curb their own spending, Reuters said.

IREN hit a new 52-week low and had 16 billionaire holders and 69 hedge fund holders as of Q2 2026.

The sell-off in IREN began with a forecast, not a failure. Gartner predicted that 80% of neocloud companies will be absorbed or stop operating by 2030, CNBC reported, and Elon Musk soon warned that more than 200 of them face consolidation. IREN had already dropped 40% in a month by then. Reuters said the shares fell another 11% after the midterm elections raised fears of tighter oversight of data centers.

Bulls say the contracts tell a different story. The company is turning bitcoin-mining sites into AI data centers, and it signed a $9.7 billion deal with Microsoft. In its latest annual results, it reported $4 billion of annualized revenue contracted for 2026 capacity and said that capacity was largely sold out. Customers have also been prepaying, covering 45% to 55% of the cost of new chips, which eases some of the borrowing worry hanging over the group. If customers keep prepaying and the capacity stays sold out, bulls argue the company can fund growth without leaning as hard on lenders, which is the very worry weighing on neocloud shares.

We covered how IREN swapped bitcoin rigs for Microsoft GPU contracts if you want the backstory.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of IREN as an investment, we believe certain AI infrastructure stocks offer far stronger long-term potential at a much more attractive entry point. If you are looking for an AI stock more promising than IREN that operates as a critical AI tollbooth and stands as the most important company in the world, check out our report about this must-own AI stock .

chineseContent:
我们刚刚发布了亿万富翁评选的纳斯达克 10 支最佳 52 周低点股票名单，IREN（纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）在此名单中排名第 10。

浏览一下本周触及 52 周低点的纳斯达克股票，就会发现一个规律：许多知名企业都在为人工智能建造、供电或租赁空间。这些业务中很少有萎缩的。最近几周，有几家公司公布了创纪录的收入，但他们的股价却一直在下滑。

一个拿着手机寻找新股的人

新的政治风险抵达华盛顿

然后是选举。路透社11月4日报道称，在民主党赢得国会后，华尔街收盘大幅走高，但数据中心股价因担心人工智能监管收紧而下跌。民主党在德克萨斯州和佐治亚州取得了进展，这两个州公众对该行业快速扩张的反对情绪不断增加。

我们还写了一篇关于杠杆如何将人工智能赌注变成一只基金的甩卖的文章。

这种压力一直持续到第二天。据路透社 11 月 5 日报道，瑞银分析师估计，预计 2028 年美国数据中心新增容量中约有 30% 可能面临建设暂停的风险。路透社称，相比之下，大型科技公司股价上涨，因为他们认为建设速度放缓将抑制自身支出。

截至 2026 年第二季度，IREN 创下 52 周新低，拥有 16 名亿万富翁持有人和 69 名对冲基金持有人。

IREN 的抛售始于预测，而不是失败。据 CNBC 报道，Gartner 预测，到 2030 年，80% 的新云公司将被吸收或停止运营，埃隆·马斯克很快警告称，其中 200 多家公司面临整合。那时IREN已经在一个月内下跌了40%。路透社称，中期选举引发了对数据中心监管收紧的担忧，该股股价又下跌 11%。

看多者表示，合同讲述了不同的故事。该公司正在将比特币挖矿站点转变为人工智能数据中心，并与微软签署了一项价值 97 亿美元的协议。在最新的年度业绩中，该公司公布了 2026 年产能合同年化收入 40 亿美元，并表示产能大部分已售罄。客户也一直在预付新芯片成本的 45% 至 55%，这在一定程度上缓解了该集团的借贷担忧。看多者认为，如果客户继续预付款且容量仍然售罄，则该公司可以为增长提供资金，而不必过度依赖贷款人，而这正是拖累 Neocloud 股价的担忧。

如果您想了解背景故事，我们介绍了 IREN 如何将比特币钻机换成微软 GPU 合同。

虽然我们承认 IREN 作为一项投资的风险和潜力，但我们相信某些人工智能基础设施股票在更具吸引力的切入点上提供了更强大的长期潜力。如果您正在寻找一只比 IREN 更有前途的人工智能股票，它是一个关键的人工智能收费站，并且是世界上最重要的公司，请查看我们关于这只必须持有的人工智能股票的报告。
